prose: AMD disclosed in a filing that it will pay about US$2.9 billion in cash and stock for Toronto AI-chip startup Taalas, with $1.4 billion contingent on unspecified conditions. The deal, announced in August, has not closed and needs regulatory approval. The Globe and Mail calls it one of the largest takeovers of a Canadian tech company, second only to the $4.75 billion Ecolab-CoolIT Systems deal in March and above Nasdaq's $2.75 billion Verafin purchase in 2020.
highlights: AMD will pay ~$2.9B in cash and stock for Taalas; $1.4B contingent
Announced in August; price disclosed in a Wednesday filing; closing needs approvals
Among the largest Canadian tech takeovers
